notes: s007 takes *so that* whole as one rendering of the single waw under rule 55; the note records that the corpus heads such units both ways, and the coordinator is taken as head.
`לֹא יָכְלוּ` is split rather than fused, the ASV writing *could not* as two words, so the negative takes only its own *not* and the modal goes to `יָכֹל` (rule 35).
The comparative `מִן` takes both *more* and *than* as one discontinuous unit under rule 25, headed on *than* with *more* named as defensible.
`לִמְעָט` → *too few* fuses under rule 30, no morpheme owning a part of the rendering.
